name: Golden Beach Beer City (金沙滩啤酒城)
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor on Qingdao West Coast's 2026 CSL home shirt, shown at the club's 4 March 2026 season-launch ceremony (kit record qingdao-west-coast-2026-home). The venue, in Qingdao West Coast New Area (Huangdao district), was built in 2015 and from 2015 hosted the Qingdao International Beer Festival every summer, six consecutive editions as of the page's content (Huangdao Development's own project page, https://www.hdfzjt.cn/jstpjc/, undated but describing the 30th festival of 31 July - 16 August 2020). Who owns or operates the venue brand could not be verified from openable primary sources: business directories list Qingdao West Coast Beer Culture Group Co., Ltd. (青岛西海岸啤酒文化集团有限公司) and Qingdao Golden Beach Beer City Operation & Management Co., Ltd. (青岛金沙滩啤酒城运营管理有限公司), both registered at the beer city's address (金沙滩路1356号) with a business scope of 'responsible for the daily operation and management of Golden Beach Beer City', while Huangdao Development (Group) Co., Ltd. (黄岛发展集团, hdfzjt.cn) lists the beer city under the major projects (重大项目) on its own site (https://www.hdfzjt.cn/jstpjc/); a Baidu Baike statement that the beer-culture group sits under Haikong Group is not citable under the repo's source rules. Sponsor stays 'not rated yet' until an ownership claim names its owner.
